name: CO2 electroreduction to CO, formic acid and ethylene
principle: CO2 is reduced at a cathode to CO (Ag, Au), formate (Pb, Sn) or ethylene (Cu). Kenis and colleagues report CO at 94% Faradaic efficiency and 91 mA/cm2 on a silver gas-diffusion electrode and say commercial use needs overpotential below 0.2 V at above 100 mA/cm2; no standard durability protocols existed in 2013.
